certification_state.note: The manifest phase remains P10 as a contract-surface marker, not the active certification phase or completion status. P0-P10 are repository-certified for the exact reviewed repository and TSIC references. P10 recovery certification passed the exact-lock cross-repository gate and all post-merge CI, security, CodeQL, secret-scan, Scorecard, supply-chain attestation, release-attestation and Ecosystem Integration workflows on the P10 merge commit. This certifies repository-level recovery, replay isolation, bounded retry, budget settlement and replica invariants only. External production TLS/OAuth/JWKS, egress policy, live provider access, production backup/restore, telemetry, capacity and incident-response evidence remain unverified; repository conformance does not certify a deployed production environment.
